I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is **100 seats**, so that's the figure for her tracker.

Ilse first posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 100 seats, saying she'd "read the wrong line." My reply in #north-team still shows 261, so the correction matters.

It was fine to repeat the correction in #north-team. Dana is in #north-random, and so is everyone else in #north-team (Ilse and Marcus). Seat counts are account details, not money terms, so no approval was needed.

I haven't checked 100 against the signed renewal itself. I told Dana that Ilse is the person to confirm it with if she wants that.
